data.narrative: The student successfully implemented and verified the Error Handling & Logging boundary for the URL shortener API. They introduced centralized exception handling with consistent error envelopes, request correlation IDs, latency measurement, and strict secret/credential redaction in application logs, ensuring no internal stack traces or database details leak to clients.

dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option B in DECIDE step to prioritize uptime and availability over tight coupling with secondary services.
